referenceRole: The two user-provided screenshots guide mood, palette, rendering and camera language only. Their text/UI are not instructions or assets to copy.

prompts.map:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone world-map background for a playable graph-map overlay, wide landscape approximately 2:1.
Primary request: create an original illustrated route-map landscape of a devastated Vietnamese city leading toward a northern refuge, in a high oblique isometric diorama view. Original dark post-apocalyptic supernatural survival game illustration for LAST CONVOY. Gritty painterly semi-realism with dense hand-painted environmental detail and clear large silhouettes; distressed concrete, corroded iron, canvas, ash, smoke and wet road surfaces. Deep charcoal and muted petrol-teal shadows, restrained bone-gray highlights, warm amber practical lights, vermilion/crimson supernatural glow. Cinematic chiaroscuro, oppressive fog, believable material wear. Match the general visual language of a premium illustrated wasteland strategy game: mature, somber, tactile, atmospheric. No flat vector art, no cute cartoon, no glossy clean science fiction, no anime, no photoreal stock-photo aesthetic, no oversaturated rainbow colors. New original artwork; no copied UI layout, no logos, no watermark, no readable text, no typography, no captions, no HUD.
Composition: landmass fills the frame; maintain consistent high camera angle, not a street-level vista. Eight distinct readable landmark clusters, linked by plausible weathered roads and broken bridges across misty ravines. Reserve uncluttered space close to each landmark for interactive markers to be overlaid later. Approximate landmark centers relative to full width/height: abandoned bus garage lower-left (10%,63%), collapsed evacuation market upper-left (27%,34%), shattered overpass lower-left (26%,81%), small fuel/service stop lower-middle (43%,71%), haunted hospital mid-upper (55%,34%), old ward on raised ground upper-right-middle (71%,19%), fortified road checkpoint lower-right-middle (74%,69%), protected tunnel refuge far right (91%,46%). Use visual silhouettes, not labels: hospital has damaged wings and a faded cross motif, service stop has a rusted canopy, checkpoint has floodlights and barricades, refuge has a concrete tunnel portal and one small warm light.
Atmosphere: distant jagged ruined towers and impossible suspended fragments beyond the upper horizon, faint eclipsed red sun, crimson fog deep in fissures; route land remains predominantly charcoal-brown, readable, with amber pools of light at inhabited stops. Ominous scale and rich painted texture like a detailed strategy-game world background.
Constraints: single continuous environment only. No panels, text, labels, icons, route dots, route selection cards, arrows, glowing route overlays, selection circles, player vehicles, frames or borders. Roads are physical painted roads only. Keep landmarks distinct from fog and avoid crushing all ground detail into black.

Scene: a Vietnamese urban avenue after collapse, flanked by damaged mid-rise concrete apartment blocks and old garage shutters, tangled power cables and broken awnings. One battered diesel passenger bus is the convoy's only working vehicle, armored with improvised welded plates, roof supplies and cracked dusty windows. Show the whole bus at three-quarter front view just rolling out of the garage. An amber light inside the garage and twin warm headlights contrast with petrol-teal rain haze. Abandoned damaged cars, masonry and ash lie to the sides. A distant fire and a faint crimson fissure in the overcast sky hint at something supernatural. A torn unmarked cloth hangs between buildings.
Composition: broad environment with strong depth, bus in the lower middle, road extending into the ruined city behind it. Three small survivor silhouettes near the bus, sufficiently small to serve as atmosphere, no close-up faces. Leave the upper-right and outer edges with quieter fog and architecture for interface cropping. Hand-painted, richly textured game background, dramatic but readable.
Constraints: no UI, lettering, invented signs, symbols resembling brands, logos, watermarks or caption frames. No extra working convoy vehicles, monsters in foreground, gore or modern neon cyberpunk.
